title: Issue Credit on a billable invoice works as before
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billable, with one part sold at $60.00.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open the Finance tab.
  3. Click Issue Credit.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The invoice shows.

Step 3:

  • The part is listed at its $60.00 credit, editable, with the restocking fee option.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11759 (Story 2, An internal or no-charge work order from creation to Close), story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • Feature Overview, Out of Scope: “Regular work orders, invoicing, payments, discounts, credits and the customer portal behave exactly as they do today.”
  • S12-E7: “After invoicing, a part of a no-charge line goes back through Issue Credit like any part: Issue Credit lists it at a $0.00 credit that cannot be edited and with no restocking fee (nothing was charged), the part returns to inventory, and its cost is reversed from the category account to inventory with the same entry a return on an internal work order uses. The $0.00 credit never blocks an invoice reversal.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
